title: Exploring Magnets
subject: curiosity
description: Understanding magnetic vs non-magnetic materials, poles of a magnet, and magnetic forces.

quizzes.question: What happens when two North poles (N-N) of bar magnets approach each other?
quizzes.explanation: Like magnetic poles (N-N or S-S) always repel each other, whereas opposite poles (N-S) attract.

quizzes.question: Where is the magnetic force strongest on a standard bar magnet?
options: At both of its magnetic poles
quizzes.explanation: Magnetic field lines are most concentrated at the poles, making the magnetic force strongest at both ends.
